verdict.rationale: Publishing third-party authorization rules is a fair question for a state tax agency, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions power-of-attorney or authorization forms, third-party or delegate roles in My DOR, or which signatures a representative cannot provide. The cited pages cover licensing, filing, payments and amendments only, and the authenticated portal was not examined.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
